metadata.purpose: Assert exactly one matching source value, retaining candidate until successful completion; distinguish empty, no match, and duplicates.

conditions: A successful finite source emits exactly one original value and complete.
A second match fails immediately; an empty source fails with EmptyError; a non-empty predicate no-match fails with NotFoundError.
Errors and cancellation discard retained state; no emission before uniqueness is known.

scope.parameters: Indexed boolean predicate; omitted BooleanConstructor and thisArg specialization.
scope.callbacks: Exactly one correlated request/outcome for every inspected source value (value,index,source).
scope.time: Only source delivery order controls candidate storage; no new clock or scheduler.
scope.reentrancy: A callback return/throw must resolve before another source notification.
exclusions: BooleanConstructor type-guard specialization, reentrant predicate/observer delivery and source initialization-time callbacks.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe to the source lazily on downstream subscription.

ownership.sharing: None introduced; each downstream subscription independently evaluates uniqueness.
ownership.reset: Presence bits, match value and predicate index start fresh for each subscription.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Indexed callback invocation is separate from source.next; candidate is held until completion.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between reactions, on source termination and on downstream cancellation.

rules.nextState: Retain precisely the state memory and resource ownership described by this rule.

rules.guard: no predicate and no previous candidate
actions: retain first source value without notifying
rules.nextState: Retain precisely the state memory and resource ownership described by this rule.

rules.guard: no predicate and candidate already stored
rules.nextState: Final terminal reason; state is no longer admissible for input.
rules.explanation: A second matching value immediately violates the single-value contract.

actions: request indexed predicate for original source value
rules.nextState: Retain precisely the state memory and resource ownership described by this rule.

actions: advance predicate index; retain previous candidate if any
rules.nextState: Retain precisely the state memory and resource ownership described by this rule.
rules.explanation: Unmatched source values still establish that the source was non-empty, but are never emitted.

rules.guard: correlated true result and no prior match
actions: retain original source value; advance predicate index
rules.nextState: Retain precisely the state memory and resource ownership described by this rule.
rules.explanation: Do not emit the first match until successful completion has ruled out a second match.

rules.guard: correlated true result and prior matching value exists
actions: error with SequenceError; release source immediately
rules.nextState: Final terminal reason; state is no longer admissible for input.
rules.explanation: Two matching values violate single even if later source values would not match.

actions: propagate exact thrown object; release source
rules.nextState: Final terminal reason; state is no longer admissible for input.
rules.explanation: A thrown predicate is an error, not a false result or missing match.

actions: emit retained original value; complete; release source
rules.nextState: Final terminal reason; state is no longer admissible for input.
rules.explanation: Exactly one match is confirmed only at successful completion.

rules.nextState: Final terminal reason; state is no longer admissible for input.

rules.explanation: No retained candidate is emitted on failure.
